route_request: route an LLM request through a litellm router with model selection and fallback logic
route_user_config_request: route a request using a user-provided router config dict and route type
create_proxy_model_not_found_error: create a ProxyModelNotFoundError HTTPException with route and model name for invalid model lookup
get_team_id_from_data: get the team id from request data metadata or litellm_metadata params
add_shared_session_to_data: add a shared aiohttp session to request data for connection reuse and automatic recovery
